name: KP Green Engineering Ltd
tagline: KP-group fabrication business - lattice towers, solar structures, PEBs, transmission towers, now galvanising - growing ~78% at ~20% EBITDA margin and only ~9x earnings after a ~56% drawdown; cheap, order-backed, but a fabrication multiple ceiling and group-governance context temper the thesis
business_overview: KP Green Engineering Ltd (NSE: KPGEL, part of the KP group / Faruk Patel), runs an integrated model: manufacturing of custom-fabricated steel products (lattice towers, monopoles, solar module-mounting structures, pre-engineered buildings, transmission-line towers, isolators, infra products) plus EPC for solar and infrastructure. Capacity ~400,500 MTPA after H2FY26 galvanising commissioning.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 1,831 Cr (incl. a new BSNL deal) - ~1.5x FY26 revenue
~Rs 507.9 Cr of confirmed orders across solar structures, transmission towers, PEBs, isolators, infra products
fundamentals_narrative: KP Green Engineering is the most quantitatively attractive of this run's KP-group / fabrication names: FY26 revenue +78% to ~Rs 1,250 Cr, PAT +85% to ~Rs 136 Cr, EBITDA margin expanded to ~20% (strong for fabrication), and the stock trades at only ~9x earnings / ~1x sales after a ~56% one-year fall. The Rs 1,831 Cr order book is ~1.5x revenue and galvanising commissioning moves the product mix up the value curve. The offsets: heavy fabrication generally carries a low-teens P/E ceiling; the ~56% drawdown signals real sentiment / execution concern (and possibly promoter-group overhang - KP group has multiple listed entities); and there is no ValuePickr thread for independent scrutiny of margins, receivables or inter-group dealings. A 10x from ~Rs 1,258 Cr needs the earnings to roughly triple and the multiple to expand toward ~25x - possible if the galvanising/value-add mix and order intake deliver, but not the base case.
technical_read: Not pulled - no dedicated thread; stock down ~56% over the year despite strong FY26 numbers.
sentiment_summary: No dedicated ValuePickr thread (Step 3.05: forum search surfaced only the KPI Green Energy thread, a different KP-group company). Research is web/filings-based only.
bse_notes: Sovrenn note (2026-05-04): new confirmed orders ~Rs 507.9 Cr across solar structures, transmission towers, PEBs, isolators and infra products. Corroborated by FY26 results (+78% revenue, +85% PAT, ~20% EBITDA margin) and the ~Rs 1,831 Cr order book. Datapoint holds up.

value_chain.theme: Steel fabrication for renewables / T&D / infrastructure (forgings & fabrication + grid adjacency)
value_chain.position: Fabricator of lattice/transmission towers, solar mounting structures, PEBs and isolators, with galvanising and EPC - upstream of solar developers and T&D EPC contractors
value_chain.bottleneck_node: Galvanising capacity and heavy-fabrication throughput; moving toward higher-value galvanised / engineered structures
value_chain.note: Touches two priority-1 themes - 'forgings / castings / fabrication for cap-goods' and 'grid / transmission equipment' (transmission towers). Genuine demand pull from India's solar + T&D capex, but fabrication is a capacity-adding, competitively-bid layer; the value-add step is galvanising and engineered structures.

drivers: operating leverage on the capacity ramp
richer mix toward galvanised / engineered structures and PEBs
earnings_quality.normalised_note: ~20% EBITDA margin is high for heavy fabrication; part is operating leverage on a fast ramp and favourable steel-cost timing. A mid-teens through-cycle margin is a safer assumption.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: FY25 revenue ~Rs 702 Cr, FY26 ~Rs 1,250 Cr (+78%); PAT +85%; EBITDA +117%. Order book ~Rs 1,831 Cr supports continued growth into FY27.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~9x trailing with ~80% growth and 1.5x-revenue order book is very cheap on growth; the 56% drawdown means the market doubts either the margin or the group context - the re-rate is the swing factor.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Reinvesting in fabrication + galvanising capacity (now ~400,500 MTPA); part of the KP group with multiple listed entities (KPI Green, KP Energy) - inter-group order flow and capital allocation warrant monitoring
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Explicit move up the curve: galvanising lines commissioned, mix shifting toward engineered / galvanised structures and PEBs

bull_case: Cheap: ~9x earnings / ~1x sales after a ~56% fall, with FY26 revenue +78% and PAT +85%
~20% EBITDA margin - strong for fabrication - and a move up the value curve via galvanising
Rs 1,831 Cr order book (~1.5x FY26 revenue), incl. a BSNL deal; ~Rs 508 Cr fresh confirmed orders
Dual priority-1 theme exposure: fabrication for cap-goods and transmission towers for the grid build-out
bear_case: Heavy fabrication rarely re-rates beyond low-teens P/E - a clean 10x needs both a big earnings ramp and sharp multiple expansion
~56% one-year drawdown signals real sentiment / execution / group-overhang concern the SME disclosures don't fully explain
KP group has multiple listed entities - inter-group order flow, RPTs and capital allocation need scrutiny (no thread to provide it)
~20% EBITDA margin carries peak-margin risk; short public track record as a standalone listed entity
verdict_headline: Cheap (~9x), fast-growing (~78%) fabrication business with ~20% margins and an order book - scored 10x-in-2-3-years at Low-Medium conviction, unconfirmed, capped by the fabrication multiple ceiling and KP-group governance context
verdict_reasoning: Sovrenn-news seed (tier 4.65). The Sovrenn datapoint (~Rs 508 Cr confirmed orders) holds up and is corroborated by FY26 results. Per the trailing-vs-live rule: strong recent trajectory + concrete order-book catalyst + a cheap small-cap -> 10x-in-2-3-years at Low-Medium conviction with an 'unconfirmed' caveat.

Caveat: heavy fabrication carries a low-teens P/E ceiling, so a true 10x needs earnings to roughly triple AND a re-rate toward ~25x - the galvanising / value-add mix shift is the key variable. The ~56% drawdown and the KP-group multi-entity structure (inter-group order flow, RPTs) are unresolved overhangs, and there is no thread for independent scrutiny.

Live-theme match: priority-1 'forgings / fabrication' and 'grid / transmission' (transmission towers) - value_chain added. No red flag (profitable, promoter-led, no SEBI/auditor/going-concern event). peak_margin_risk true. conviction Low-Medium; revisit_after_30d false. Re-check FY27 quarterly margins and any disclosure on inter-group transactions.

four_box.note: Grid/transmission-tower fabrication tailwind real but heavy fabrication 'rarely re-rates beyond low-teens P/E' per bear_case — weak; ~Rs508cr confirmed orders corroborated by FY26 results support tam; no moat for a fabrication business (peak-margin risk flagged) — no; ~56% 1yr drawdown is an unresolved sentiment/execution/group-overhang concern, not a clear valuation signal — weak. KP-group inter-entity RPT structure is a separate unscrutinized risk.
